answer: Proof of replication. To earn a storage slot, encode a lagoon image archive, horizon measurements, or nectar assay records with a unique account-bound encoding and commit its root. The verifier challenges random blocks after commitment and requires proofs before a short deadline. N slots require N distinct stored replicas, costing disk capacity and ongoing availability. This assumes replicas resist compression and cannot be regenerated within the deadline; otherwise an attacker could serve many accounts from one copy.
